Tabs.style_guide: Use 'TabsList' with a p-1 bg-slate-100/50 rounded-xl. 'TabsTrigger' should be large (h-14), incorporating an icon and text side-by-side or stacked. Active state must pop with white bg and shadow.
Tabs.customization: Override default height restrictions. Allow triggers to be flexible.

GradeCard.description: A large, clean card representing a school grade (e.g., 'Primer Grado').
structure: Header: Optional subtle geometric background or icon.
Content: 'X Asignaturas' count with a muted text color.
Action: 'Gestionar asignaturas' button, full width or right aligned, outline style.
GradeCard.styling: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl hover:-translate-y-1 transition-transform duration-300

variants.primary: bg-[#001f4b] text-white hover:bg-[#001636] rounded-lg px-6 py-3 font-medium
variants.outline: border-2 border-slate-200 bg-transparent hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 rounded-lg

layout_strategy.page_structure: Max-width container (max-w-7xl) centered. Header section with Title and Breadcrumbs. Main content area dominated by the Tabs component.
layout_strategy.grid_system: Grid of cards: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3. Use gap-8 for a spacious, premium feel.
layout_strategy.whitespace: Aggressive use of whitespace. Don't crowd the cards. Let the typography breathe.

images.description: Subtle abstract geometric shapes for card headers

universal_guidelines.testing: All interactive elements MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., 'tab-inicial', 'btn-manage-grade-1').
universal_guidelines.transitions: Do NOT use 'transition: all'. Specify properties (e.g., 'transition-colors', 'transition-transform').
universal_guidelines.accessibility: Ensure contrast ratios are met. Use semantic HTML where possible.
universal_guidelines.theme: Light Mode only for this module (as per premium education standard).

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Refactor the 'SubjectsPage' to use the 'Tabs' component as the main organizer. 2. Create a new 'GradeCard' component following the style guide. 3. Ensure the 'Gestionar asignaturas' flow remains functional but visually updated. 4. Use the provided image URLs as subtle headers or backgrounds for the cards to add a 'premium' touch.
